label: rem:phi-q-tower-jsj-bridge
title: Φ$_q$ tower equals $\rho_q \cdot \sum_S \mathrm{Vol}(K_S)$ (archimedean bridge)
html:
Superseded. The scalar substrate density \rho_q = 1/\hbar_q^2 used below is the structurally-wrong leading-order ansatz; the operator-valued form supersedes it (mass-endomorphism-tower).

Conjecture (\Phi_q-JSJ archimedean bridge). Under the archimedean realization, each summand of the dilogarithm tower evaluates precisely to the hyperbolic volume of the corresponding \Phi_q-piece, weighted by the substrate density:

  \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\!\bigl(z^{\lvert S\rvert} \cdot \Phi_q(\|V_S\|_F)\bigr)
  \;=\;
  \rho_q \cdot
  \mathrm{Vol}_{\mathrm{hyp}}(S^3 \setminus K_S).

Summing over all subsets reconstructs the continuous JSJ piecewise sum.

This conjecture aligns the algebraic discrete evaluation with the geometric continuous evaluation. The dilogarithm pipeline and the hyperbolic-volume pipeline compute the identical archimedean target through different convergence regimes. It formalizes the quantum Bloch group regulator mapping the algebraic strata directly onto the JSJ decomposition.
